native

First-party Tiinex native artifacts, scaffolds, entries, processes, and other qualified building blocks consumed by Core and hosts.

Grounding boundary:
- Docs owns semantic contracts.
- Core owns host-neutral mechanics and projections.
- Native owns maintained first-party qualified content.
- Do not move Core mechanics or Docs authority into Native merely to centralize files.
- Do not invent or freeze the native directory taxonomy merely to populate this repository; follow qualified Tiinex structure/scaffolding work when it exists.
